lines: It has 3,788 stars and is TypeScript.
Developers struggle to run natural language tests across web and mobile apps on every pull request or schedule.
e2e is a next-generation testing framework for web and mobile. It runs natural language tests on pull requests or schedules.
It uses a web engine for browsers and an agent-device engine to run tests on iOS or Android simulators.
Input is a natural language prompt like upgrade to Pro. The result is an automated check that verifies the member became Pro.
The project is under active development heading toward version 1.
@e2e-dev/github posts results as a PR comment.
The CLI writes a config and an example test after you ask for an engine, web or mobile.
The project is in active development on the way to version 1.
Built by Tester Army with licence under active development to version 1.
Run npx e2e init to choose an engine and get a config with an example test.
Send this to someone who wants simpler end-to-end tests for their web or mobile apps.
Try the next-gen framework from tester-army slash e2e.
